scenes.voiceover: Can a girl from Kerala become the mayor of Los Angeles?
scenes.image_prompt: Kerala coastline transforming into LA skyline with bold arrow and MAYOR'S RACE 2026 ticker

scenes.voiceover: Nithya Raman left India at six. Harvard. MIT. Urban planning degree in hand.
scenes.image_prompt: Education timeline infographic showing journey from age 6 to Harvard to MIT

scenes.voiceover: She went back to India — seven years mapping slums in Chennai, fighting for the forgotten.
scenes.image_prompt: Chennai map with data markers showing informal settlement mapping work

scenes.voiceover: In LA she found a hundred million going to homelessness — ninety percent spent jailing people, not housing them.
scenes.image_prompt: Budget breakdown donut chart showing 90% jailing vs 10% housing of $100M

scenes.voiceover: She unseated a seventeen-year incumbent. First South Asian on the LA City Council, ever.
scenes.onscreen: FIRST SOUTH ASIAN — LA CITY COUNCIL
scenes.image_prompt: Political milestone card with LA City Hall and FIRST SOUTH ASIAN achievement

scenes.voiceover: Now she faces Mayor Karen Bass in November. Her pledge: halve tent camps before the twenty-twenty-eight Olympics.
scenes.image_prompt: Election matchup graphic with Raman vs Bass and 2028 Olympics pledge

scenes.voiceover: A hundred and twenty thousand Indian Americans call LA home. Could one of them run it?
scenes.image_prompt: Diaspora statistics card with 120K population, 40% growth, and mayoral question
